`step9c_baseline.py compare` could not produce it. Two reasons, both recorded
rather than worked around:

   detached at 59697bcbef6) and then blocked inside the per-file pristine

Route taken instead: the per-file pristine check the tool itself prints on its
own `_Indeterminate` path, but at CHECK granularity rather than pytest
granularity — each failing node's underlying `workflow_lint` check run on BOTH
trees, with a line-number-invariant row-set diff. This is strictly stronger
than per-node attribution: it compares the violation SETS, so a line-shift
cannot masquerade as a new violation and a new violation cannot hide behind a
node that was already red. It also happens to be the same instrument
`compare`'s own #2316 `VIOLATION_SET_SCAN_NODES` arm uses.
